items.condition: The submission uses a different connectivity, atom count, charge, multiplicity, or Fe atom mapping than the supplied 1H system.

A complete_validated submission supplies no frequency/minimum evidence or no physically comparable spin-state evidence; a bounded_failure submission is acceptable only when it documents the attempted validation and scientific reason for failure.
Reported distance or Mössbauer values lack a reproducible computational artifact, extraction, or site identity.
The report presents paper/reference values as calculated outputs or relies on inaccessible paper-only inputs rather than documenting an independent calculation.
